item.title: Man found guilty of stabbing, killing another man at Valero gas station on Airline Highway
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A jury found a man guilty of stabbing and killing another man at a Valero gas station, the East Baton Rouge District Attorney's Office said.Francis Vasquez Aguilar killed 39-year-old Anibal Antonio Galeas Mancia in 2022 at a gas station on Airline Highway. He was 19 when he committed the murder.Aguilar was found guilty of second-degree murder and obstruction of justice.Permalink| Comments

item.title: New Orleans jail escapee Antoine Massey sentenced to 60 years on rape, kidnapping counts
item.description: SLIDELL &mdash; New Orleans jail escapee Antoine Massey was sentenced Thursday to 60 years in prison on rape, kidnapping and other charges.Massey was among 10 inmates who escaped from the Orleans Parish Jail last May. He was free for more than a month before U.S. marshals arrested him in the Hollygrove neighborhood of New Orleans.
